codex_consult.feedback_summary: Two findings: (1) Flavor is re-inferred not preserved during peak-snapshot rewrites — if rollout becomes unavailable later, codex entry can be misidentified as claude. PROPOSED_FIX: carry flavor as 4th field in raw_sessions or pass JSON rows directly. (2) find_codex_rollout returns first filesystem match; a stale/corrupt rollout could mask a valid one. PROPOSED_FIX: add find_valid_codex_rollout that sorts newest-first and returns first validated candidate. Both findings are real correctness concerns but require scope expansion beyond BA-authorized scope.
